title: Understanding Baby Crying
objectives: Respond to crying step by step
Know what to do when you feel overwhelmed
steps: Crying is how baby calls for help when hungry or uncomfortable. Newborns routinely cry 1 to 4 hours a day.
Check the basics, such as hungry, cold, a wet diaper or sleepy, and meet the most pressing need first.
Respond promptly during the first few months. You cannot spoil a young baby with attention.
Try rocking baby in a chair or in your arms, or walking with baby in your arms or a stroller.
Try safe swaddling, gently stroking baby's head or patting their back, and singing, talking or soft music.
If you start to feel you can't handle the situation, set baby down in a safe location and get help from a family member or friend.
Never shake a baby. Shaking an infant hard can cause blindness, brain damage or even death.
source_title: AAP HealthyChildren.org: Responding To Your Baby's Cries
related_task: Soothe baby during the evening fussy time
disclaimer: Based on AAP guidance (HealthyChildren.org). Not medical advice.

questions.prompt: A relative says picking up a one-month-old every time they cry will spoil them. What does the guidance say?
options: Let baby cry so they learn to wait
Respond only after ten minutes of crying
Respond promptly; you cannot spoil a young baby with attention
questions.explanation: The best way to handle crying in the first few months is to respond promptly. You cannot spoil a young baby with attention.

questions.prompt: Baby starts crying. What is a good first step?
options: Check the basics, such as hungry, cold, wet or sleepy, and meet the most pressing need first
Turn up music to cover the sound
Wait until the crying stops by itself
Give baby a bath right away
questions.explanation: Crying is how baby calls for help when hungry or uncomfortable, so start with the most pressing need.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a soothing technique from the lesson?
options: Bouncing baby quickly up and down
Leaving baby alone in a bright, noisy room
Feeding baby again right after a full feeding
Rocking baby in your arms, or safe swaddling
questions.explanation: Rocking, walking, safe swaddling, gentle stroking or patting, and singing or soft music are the techniques listed.

questions.prompt: Baby has cried for a long time, nothing helps, and you feel you can't handle it. What should you do?
options: Shake baby gently to get their attention
Set baby down in a safe location and get help from a family member or friend
Keep holding baby no matter how upset you feel
Leave the home for a while without telling anyone
questions.explanation: Set baby down in a safe location and get help. Never shake a baby: shaking an infant hard can cause blindness, brain damage or even death.
